html:
Here is a mosaic of two photos of the total eclipse of February 20, 2008.
Photo taken at the prime focus of the 8" LX90 with a Canon Rebel XTI DSLR.
Settings: 8 seconds exposure at ISO 200 at F/10. No dark, no flat.
Software: No processing.
Site: Grand-Mère in Mauricie.
